BiblicalUsage: The priest looks at the plague in the walls of the house, and if the hollow marks are greenish or reddish and lower than the wall, the house is unclean.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that uncleanness can hide in the walls of a house, and God sees it even when I do not.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
